tokens.name: surface-0
tokens.usage: Page background, header and left sidebar. The darkest layer in dark mode; in light mode the page is one step below the panels.

tokens.name: surface-1
tokens.usage: Panels, dialog bodies, inputs, the header's grouped toolbar. In light mode this is the brightest layer.

tokens.name: surface-2
tokens.usage: Raised controls: secondary buttons, chips, code spans, hover fill on ghost buttons. At 40% it tints list rows.

tokens.name: surface-3
tokens.usage: Hover state of secondary buttons and of anything resting on surface-2.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: The 1px border and inset ring everywhere: panel dividers, inputs, secondary buttons, dialog header and footer rules. Decorative only, 1.3:1 on surface-0.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Hover ring on secondary buttons, the scrollbar thumb, the 1px shadow-panel hairline.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and hover text on every surface. 15.8:1 on surface-0 dark, 14.5:1 light.

tokens.name: ink-dim
tokens.usage: Secondary text: ghost-button labels, header toolbar labels, metadata values, descriptions. 7.8:1 dark, 7.0:1 light on surface-0.

tokens.name: ink-faint
tokens.usage: Labels, uppercase section headings, hints, the version tag, Loading and Empty text. The UI's most used text color at 11px. Raised from the source's 0.55 in both themes to clear 4.5:1: 5.1:1 on surface-0, 4.9:1 on surface-1 and 4.6:1 on surface-2 in dark; 5.0:1, 5.4:1 and 4.6:1 in light. Still 4.1:1 on surface-3, so not for text on a hovered control.

tokens.name: ink-ghost
tokens.usage: Placeholder text only. 2.3:1 dark, 2.6:1 light: never for content.

tokens.name: accent-50
tokens.usage: Label on primary buttons (accent-600 fill). 3.9:1 on accent-600, 2.9:1 on the accent-500 hover fill: below 4.5:1 for the 12px label in the source; kept exact.

tokens.name: accent-200
tokens.usage: Text of info-severity compatibility rows on an accent-500 5% fill. Darkens in light mode.

tokens.name: accent-300
tokens.usage: Accent text: the 'rendering' indicator, accent links in the inspector. 9.4:1 dark, 5.8:1 light on surface-0.

tokens.name: accent-400
tokens.usage: The 'studio' half of the wordmark; the rendering ping ring. 7.4:1 dark, 4.7:1 light on surface-0.

tokens.name: accent-500
tokens.usage: Copper, the wire. Primary button hover fill; input focus border at 60%; text selection at 30%; the loading ping; active sidebar row tint at 5%. 5.9:1 on surface-0 dark, 3.0:1 light: a fill, not a text color.

tokens.name: accent-600
tokens.usage: Primary button fill and the loading dot's core. Same value in both themes.

tokens.name: accent-700
tokens.usage: Declared in the source for the pressed end of the primary range; no UI surface uses it yet.

tokens.name: agent-300
tokens.usage: Agent text: the Agent header button, the agent sidebar's Send label and its tool-call lines. 9.3:1 dark, 7.2:1 light on surface-0.

tokens.name: agent-400
tokens.usage: The agent's 'thinking' pulse dot; the Send button ring at 40%.

tokens.name: agent-500
tokens.usage: Agent fills: Send button at 20% (hover 30%), agent textarea focus border at 60%, hover wash at 10%, the agent checkbox accent. Violet marks AI surfaces and nothing else.

tokens.name: emerald-100
tokens.usage: Text of the solver banner when every pin resolved, on an emerald-500 10% fill. Dark value is Tailwind v4's default; the light override is the source's.

tokens.name: emerald-200
tokens.usage: ADC1 pin-tag text on emerald-500 10%.

tokens.name: emerald-300
tokens.usage: The Save button's 'Saved' state on emerald-500 20%; inline success text.

tokens.name: emerald-400
tokens.usage: The 'copied' check icon.

tokens.name: emerald-500
tokens.usage: Success fill and ring base: 10% fill, 20% saved button, 30% or 40% ring. Never as text.

tokens.name: amber-100
tokens.usage: Text of warn-severity compatibility rows and of the solver banner with issues, on amber-500 10%.

tokens.name: amber-200
tokens.usage: Pin-tag text for boot HIGH, boot LOW and ADC2.

tokens.name: amber-300
tokens.usage: Inline cautions in the inspector (pull-up required, revision unset); the sidebar count badge on amber-500 15%.

tokens.name: amber-400
tokens.usage: The 'Unsaved changes' header chip, on amber-500 10% with an amber-500 30% ring.

tokens.name: amber-500
tokens.usage: Warning fill and ring base: 5% or 10% fill, 15% badge, 30% or 40% ring. Never as text.

tokens.name: rose-200
tokens.usage: Error text: danger buttons, error-severity rows, render errors, the input-only / TX / RX pin tags, on rose-500 10% or 15%.

tokens.name: rose-300
tokens.usage: Remove and Delete button text; destructive hover text; conflicting-pin counts in the pinout.

tokens.name: rose-400
tokens.usage: The unsaved marker dot beside a design id; destructive hover on the sidebar delete control.

tokens.name: rose-500
tokens.usage: Error fill and ring base: 10% or 15% fill, 25% hover, 30% or 40% ring. Never as text.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: The wordmark in the header: 'wire' in ink, 'studio' in accent-400. Nothing else is set this large.

styles.name: heading
styles.usage: The selected component's name at the top of the inspector.

styles.name: subheading
styles.usage: Dialog titles and banner lead lines.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Pick a board, then add components by function.
styles.usage: Dialog body copy, input text, Empty placeholders, design descriptions. The largest running text in the UI.

styles.name: ui
styles.usage: The default UI size: toolbar text, list rows, inspector rows, banners, hints. Most of the interface is set here.

styles.name: ui-medium
styles.usage: Button labels, header chips, emphasized values.

styles.name: small
styles.sample: Pins the solver could not place are listed above.
styles.usage: Dense secondary text: dialog subtitles, warning detail, small-button labels, library ids.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: FieldLabel and inspector section headings, always uppercase in ink-faint. Section headings use weight 600 at 12px.

styles.name: micro
styles.usage: Category chips in the inspector, uppercase on surface-2; the smallest counts and tags.

styles.name: fine
styles.usage: Pin-grid annotations in the pinout view only.

styles.name: code
styles.usage: Component ids, pin names, library ids, GPIO numbers, rail names, key-value values. Anything a user could paste into design.json.

styles.name: code-medium
styles.usage: The version tag beside the wordmark; the chip-variant badge on a board.

styles.name: code-small
styles.usage: Solver assignment lists, bracketed warning codes, DRC detail lines, YAML editors.

spacing.note: Tailwind's 4px scale, only the steps the UI uses.

tokens.name: space-0.5
tokens.usage: Vertical padding on chips, tags and small badges; the tightest list rhythm.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap in small buttons; the header toolbar's inner inset; the gap under a label before its hint.

tokens.name: space-1.5
tokens.usage: Vertical padding of buttons and inputs; chip horizontal padding; icon-to-label gap in medium buttons.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: The default gap between sibling controls; chip and small-button horizontal padding; compact panel padding.

tokens.name: space-2.5
tokens.usage: Input horizontal padding.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Medium button horizontal padding; panel padding; gap between a banner's text and its dismiss control.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Header and banner horizontal padding; dialog outer margin; gap between header groups; dialog header vertical padding.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Dialog header, body and footer horizontal padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Vertical rhythm between inspector sections.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Vertical padding of the Loading and Empty placeholders.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Checkboxes and the inline count badge in the sidebar.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: The default: buttons, inputs, chips, code spans, warning rows, list rows, menu items.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Grouped toolbars such as the header's button group; the scrollbar thumb.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Dialog panels only.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Status dots, the loading ping, the agent pulse.

tokens.name: shadow-panel
tokens.usage: Dialogs and floating panels: a 1px hairline in the theme's line color plus one soft drop. The only elevation in the UI.

tokens.name: shadow-pop
tokens.usage: Primary buttons only.

size.note: Fixed dimensions the components depend on.

tokens.name: header-height
tokens.usage: The app header row; the grid below it takes the rest of the viewport.

tokens.name: icon-md
tokens.usage: Lucide icons in buttons, the header and dialog close controls (h-4 w-4).

tokens.name: icon-sm
tokens.usage: Lucide icons inside rows, chips and the copy control (h-3.5 w-3.5).

tokens.name: icon-xs
tokens.usage: Lucide icons beside 11px text and the agent checkbox (h-3 w-3).

tokens.name: status-dot
tokens.usage: The loading, rendering and agent pulse dots; the unsaved marker is 6px.
